title: Sun and moon letter sort cards
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: The weekend; Basem in the village; the little mouse and the lion
source: Written for arabic/y4 lesson 2 (Sun and moon letter sort cards (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 2: Bridge: the word al-; sun and moon letters. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Sun letters
points: The ل is silent; the next letter doubles

blocks.title: Sort into: Moon letter (say al-) / Sun letter (l silent)
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Moon letter (say al-), Sun letter (l silent).
blocks.answer: Moon letter (say al-): القَمَر; البَيْت; المَسْجِد; الكِتَاب. Sun letter (l silent): الشَّمْس; السَّبْت; النُّور; الدَّرْس

keywords.def: sun letters: the l is silent
moon letters: the l is said

questions.q: Core: Add ال and write sun or moon: بَاب، سَيَّارَة، مَسْجِد، دَرْس، قَمَر، نُور.
questions.a: البَاب moon; السَّيَّارَة sun; المَسْجِد moon; الدَّرْس sun; القَمَر moon; النُّور sun

questions.q: Extend: Read aloud to your partner in a breakout room: الشَّمْس، القَمَر، الكِتَاب، السَّبْت.
Stretch: Find one sun letter word and one moon letter word in Surah al-Fatihah.

questions.a: B) as-sabt. س is a sun letter, so the lam is silent and the س doubles: as-sabt.

questions.q: Which is a sun letter word? A) القَمَر B) الشَّمْس C) البَاب
Big question: why do we sometimes not hear the l in al-?
questions.a: Before a sun letter the l is silent and the next letter is doubled with a shaddah.
